_comment: Every OSC address TouchFree sends on the Body Data Stream. Generated from edge/body_detector.LANDMARK_NAMES; do not hand-edit. One float per address, always. Everything is a float, flags included.

transport.bundling: packed into bundles under 1472 bytes so nothing fragments

/touchfree/person.note: 1.0 while a person is tracked. Gate everything on this.

screen_2d._note: Mirrored screen space, already normalised. +x right, +y DOWN, so invert y whenever 'up' should mean 'more'. Needs Body landmarks on.

metric_3d._note: Metres, not mirrored, anatomical. +x the body's own right, +y up, +z the way it faces. Needs Body 3D metric on as well.

/touchfree/3d/valid.note: gate the rest of /3d on this

/touchfree/3d/rotation/x|y|z.note: can flip to the mirror-image answer; prefer position

hands._note: 21 points per hand from a dedicated hand model. Needs Hand landmarks on.

silence_means_unseen: A joint the camera could not see is NOT sent: its x, y, z and vis all stop together. Hold your last value, and use a timeout on the address rather than watching vis, which stops too. Gate the whole mapping on /touchfree/person.
joint_note: The first 17 are the standard COCO body set. The rest add face detail, hands and feet.
